# DeepAgent

## Description
Multi-agent AI toolkit with research and job search capabilities using LangGraph, Tavily, and SerpAPI.

## Tech Stack
Python 3.11, LangGraph, LangChain, Tavily, SerpAPI, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Mistral Small, Streamlit, SMTP (Gmail)

## Core Files
- app.py: Streamlit UI with two tabs (Research Agent + Job Search Agent)
- research_agent.py: LangGraph agent with 4 nodes — research (Tavily), draft (Gemini 2.5 Flash), critique (Mistral), email. Conditional revision loop up to 2 iterations.
- job_agent.py: LangGraph agent with 4 nodes — search (Tavily + SerpAPI Google Jobs), filter (Mistral JSON), cover_letter (Mistral), email (SMTP).

## Key Patterns
- StateGraph with TypedDict state, 4 nodes each, one conditional edge (research_agent)
- Tavily search_depth="advanced", max_results=8, include_raw_content=True
- SerpAPI engine="google_jobs" for job listings
- Mistral JSON output parsed with fallback to regex URL extraction
- SMTP with STARTTLS (port 587) fallback to SSL (port 465)
- Job filter: regex-based exclusion of aggregators, social media, salary pages

## Entry Point
streamlit run app.py

## API Keys (.env)
TAVILY_API_KEY, SERPAPI_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, MISTRAL_API_KEY, EMAIL_ADDRESS, EMAIL_PASSWORD

## CLI Usage
python research_agent.py "What is LangGraph?"
python job_agent.py
